GetCell.description: Returns a cell by its position in the current row.

params.description: The cell position in the table row.
params.name: nPos

GetCellsCount.description: Returns a number of cells in the current row.

GetClassType.description: Returns the type of the ApiTableRow class.

GetHeight.description: Returns the height of the current table row.

GetNext.description: Returns the next row if exists.

returns.description: returns null if row is last.

GetParentTable.description: Returns the parent table of the current row.

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

GetPrevious.description: Returns the previous row if exists.

returns.description: returns null if row is first.

SetHeight.description: Sets the height to the current table row.

params.description: The row height in English measure units.
params.name: nValue
